info.name: Smile.io REST Activities Reward Fulfillments API

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Filter results to only reward fulfillments with the provided Smile customer ID.

params.name: fulfillment_status
params.description: Filter results to only reward fulfillments whose fulfillment status matches the provided value.

params.name: usage_status
params.description: Filter results to only reward fulfillments whose usage status matches the provided values.

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Filter results to only reward fulfillments updated after the provided date and time.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of reward fulfillments to retrieve.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for the page of reward fulfillments to retrieve.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of reward fulfillments.
